scripts.dev: concurrently --names API,MOBILE "npm.cmd run api:dev" "npm.cmd run mobile:dev"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently --names API,WEB "npm.cmd run api:dev" "npm.cmd run mobile:web"
scripts.dev:web:clear: concurrently --names API,WEB "npm.cmd run api:dev" "npm.cmd run mobile:web:clear"
scripts.mobile:dev: cross-env EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3000 npm.cmd --prefix mobile run dev
scripts.mobile:web: cd mobile && cross-env EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3000 npx.cmd expo start --web
scripts.mobile:web:clear: cd mobile && cross-env EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3000 npx.cmd expo start --clear --web
scripts.mobile:prod: cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://homevault-production.up.railway.app npm.cmd --prefix mobile run dev
scripts.mobile:web:prod: cd mobile && cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=https://homevault-production.up.railway.app npx.cmd expo start --clear --web
scripts.check: npm.cmd run api:build && npm.cmd run typecheck
scripts.prisma:migrate: cd api && npx.cmd prisma migrate deploy --config=prisma7.config.ts
scripts.install:all: npm.cmd install && npm.cmd --prefix api install && npm.cmd --prefix mobile install
scripts.install:ci: npm.cmd ci && npm.cmd --prefix api ci && npm.cmd --prefix mobile ci
scripts.eas:preview: cd mobile && cross-env EAS_NO_VCS=1 EAS_PROJECT_ROOT=C:\Code\homevault\mobile npx.cmd eas-cli@latest build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.eas:env:preview: cd mobile && npx.cmd eas-cli@latest env:list --environment preview
